text:
Smuggling and misery.

Shacks, prostitutes,

sweat and clouds of dust.

Children with sad eyes

and swollen bellies.

Calvary of women border-porters.

Frontier.

Hunger, dirty deals.

Rachitic soldiers

and fat generals.


Sergeants, foremen

of whip and cane,

cards and shootouts.

Frontier.

There the land wounded

on all four sides.

The people raw flesh.

Smuggling and misery.

The whole homeland a frontier!

translation.title: Smuggling and Misery...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the clipped indictment of the border as exploitation, hunger, and a wounded homeland.
